content: I had such high hopes for this foam mattress based on the glowing reviews, but it has been a total nightmare since day one. Even after letting it air out for the recommended 72 hours, the overpowering chemical smell still lingers in my bedroom like a toxic cloud. The firmness level is deceptive, as it feels like sleeping on a concrete slab that somehow manages to swallow you whole once you actually settle in. Within just a few weeks of use, I noticed a permanent indentation forming right in the center, which makes rolling over impossible. My back pain has significantly increased since making the switch to this mattress, leaving me exhausted every single morning. I reached out to customer support about the defects, but they have been completely non-responsive to my emails. This was a complete waste of money, and I honestly regret getting rid of my old bed. Do yourself a favor and steer clear of this product unless you enjoy waking up in agony.
